*_The trope of the "damsel in distress" is subverted by a female protagonist who is capable of defending herself and others with her words, rather than relying on physical strength._*

Her delicate features and slender frame make her an unlikely candidate for heroism, but her words have the power to inspire and intimidate in equal measure.
